div "> Accessible Room Features & Amenities
Please note that our rooms and suites are ADA compliant under the Department of Justice ADA Title III Regulation 28 CFR Part 36, 1991. Accessible rooms are available. We also invite you to view our Accessibility Statement.
All accessible rooms at The Carriage House feature:
Accessible room entrance doors and bathroom doors that provide at least 32 inches of clearance.
At least 30 inches of width on the side of the bed to allow for wheelchair access and transfer.
Desks (if present) that provide knee and toe clearance that is at least 27 inches high, 30 inches wide, and runs at least 17 inches deep.
Toilet seats with heights of 17-19 inches and grab bars to facilitate transfer.
Bathroom sinks that provide knee clearance of at least 30 inches wide, 27 inches tall and 17 inches deep. All of the under-sink plumbing is wrapped.
Bathroom mirrors with the lowest reflective edge at no more than 40 inches high.
Accessible bathing features - transfer, standard roll-in, or alternate roll-in shower or accessible tub - with grab bars and a detachable hand-held shower wand.
All wall mounted shower/bath accessories and equipment are within 48 inches of the floor.
Please see individual room descriptions for details. We are also available 24/7 at 702-798-1020 to provide more information.

div "> Frequently Asked Questions
Get Answers
If you have questions, we have answers. Browse our most frequently asked questions below to discover more about The Carriage House Hotel Las Vegas and start planning your Sin City getaway. For any further inquiries, feel free to give us a call at 702.798.1020.
How do owners make a reservation or bank their week with an exchange company?
Reservations for The Carriage House or banking requests are done with Reservations. Requests can be done by telephone, email, fax or regular mail. Please be sure to include your Carriage House and exchange company member number.
Telephone: (800) 221-2301 ext. 280 or (702) 798-1020
Email: reservations@carriagehouselasvegas.com
Fax: (702) 798-0007
Mail: 105 E Harmon Ave, Las Vegas, NV
What exchange companies are available to carriage house owners? 7Across (formerly DAE) | www.7across.com | (800) 468-1799
Interval International (II) | www.intervalworld.com | (800) 843-8843
Resort Condominiums International (RCI) | www.rci.com | (800) 338-7777
Hawaii Timeshare Exchange (HTSE) | www.htse.net | (866) 860-4873
Platinum Interchange | www.platinuminterchange.com | (800) 854-2324
The Club Select (DRI) | www.diamondresorts.com | (877) 787-0906
Trading Places International | www.tradingplaces.com | (800) 365-7617
Can owners book at the carriage house or exchange their week for next year?
In order to book or bank your week for next year, the estimated Annual Maintenance Assessments must be prepaid. Owners may call Reservations to pay over the phone with a credit card or mail in a check, with their written request.
When does carryover time expire and what are the restrictions when booking carryover time?
Unused vacation time, for the current year, may be carried over into the next year if the Annual Maintenance Assessments are paid in full by the end of the current year. Carryover time is subject to the following restrictions:
Carryover time is available from January through August.
Carryover time is not available from September through December.
Bronze season owners may only book April and May, excluding holidays.
Carryover time cannot be split.
Carryover time cannot be used with an exchange company.
Carryover time cannot be booked more than 90 days in advance.
Annual Maintenance Assessments, for the previous year and the current year, must be paid in full in order to make reservations using carryover time.
Are room upgrades available?
Owners can request a room upgrade 30 days or less prior to arrival. All requests are confirmed on a space available basis and subject to nightly upgrade fees. Please email or call Reservations for more information.
Are season upgrades available? There are three travel seasons at The Carriage House.
Owners can request a season upgrade 30 days or less prior to arrival. All requests are confirmed on a space available basis and subject to nightly upgrade fees. Please email or call Reservations for more information
Gold: January 1st–December 31st, including holidays
Silver: January 1st–December 31st, excluding holidays
Bronze: April 1st–May 31st, excluding holidays AND September 1st–December 31st excluding holidays
What is the cancellation policy for owner reservations?
Owners must notify Reservations—by telephone, email, or fax—at least 14 days prior to arrival to have their week reinstated.
Is RV or oversized vehicle parking allowed?
No oversized vehicles are permitted.
Are animals allowed on property?
No, only service animals are allowed on property.
